name: sathyabama-student-portal
description: Blazing fast frontend wrapper and REST proxy for Sathyabama Student Portal

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('public')) fs.mkdirSync('public'); ['index.html','styles.css','app.js','portal-api.js','sw.js','favicon.png','favicon.ico','manifest.json'].forEach(f => { if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'public/' + f); }); console.log('Static assets synced to public/');"
